title: Atlantis NDT Company Brochure 2026 (PDF Download)
description: View or download the Atlantis NDT 2026 company brochure: NDT training, outside Level III consulting, Practical NDT, Digital Twins and Atlantis ERP.
intro: Our 2026 company profile in one 16-page PDF: NDT training from Level I to Level III, outside Level III consulting, client and class-society approval projects, and the software we build for inspection people. Read it here or download it to share with your team.

contents.p: An NDT consulting, training and technology firm led by an ASNT NDT Level III in RT, UT, MT, PT and VT, working across oil and gas, maritime, aerospace, petrochemical and power from the USA and India.
Training, consulting and technology, and how they fit together.

Level I and Level II method courses, ASNT Level III Basic and method preparation, advanced UT awareness (PAUT and TOFD), qualification programmes and refresher courses, delivered online, in the classroom, onsite or in the Practical NDT 3D campus.
Outside Level III and Level III of record, procedures and techniques, written practice and qualification, audits and compliance, laboratory support, and client and regulatory approvals.
Preparing NDT and inspection suppliers for client, regulatory and class-society approvals: gap assessment, documentation, personnel records, audit support and surveillance.
Oil and gas, maritime, aerospace, petrochemical and power, and the methods we train, consult and build for: RT, UT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT, TOFD, ET, MFL, LRUT, IRIS and PMI.
A browser-based 3D inspection campus where trainees set up instruments, follow written procedures and report findings, on desktop, mobile and VR.
A 3D model of each asset carrying its thickness readings, corrosion trends and inspection history, with reports from the same screen.
An ERP configured for NDT companies, from the first enquiry to the signed report and the paid invoice.

contents.h: One connected ecosystem, and how we work
contents.p: Train, inspect, report, manage — and the path from discovery call to proposal, delivery and ongoing support.
